items.description:
*Note: We have extended the retirement date to March 31, 2027.On March 31, 2027 API keys used query application
insights will be retired. You'll need to transition to
Microsoft Entra ID (formerly known as Azure AD) which provides all the
functionality of API keys plus new ones, including:  
 Microsoft
     Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) Multi-Factor Authentication.  
 Hybrid
     integration to write password changes back to on-premises
     environment.  
 Hybrid
     integration to enforce password protection policies for an on-premises
     environment.  Recommended action:  To continue querying your application insights resource,
switch to Microsoft
Entra authentication for application insights by March 31, 2027.  Help and support: Get answers from community experts
in Microsoft Q&A. If
you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support
request:  For Issue
     type, select Technical.    For Subscription,
     select your subscription.    For Service,
     click My services.    For Service
     type, select Application Insights.    For Resource,
     select the Azure resource that you are creating a support request
     for.    For Summary,
     type a description of your issue.    For Problem
     type, select A feature that I use is deprecated and will be removed
     from application insights.    For Problem
     subtype, select API keys for querying are being
     retiredMicros
items.title: Retirement: Transition to Entra ID (formerly known as Azure AD) to query data from Azure Monitor application insights by March 31, 2027
